title: AI selection: which harness, provider, model and thinking effort runs a task
description: Every field is optional; layers merge field by field (task > skill > config override > agent > config default). A layer that names a different harness drops the provider and model inherited from lower layers; effort carries over. model/provider without a harness in the resolved result are invalid.

provider.description: Provider id listed by that harness.

model.description: Model id as the harness/provider names it.

effort.description: Thinking effort; the harness descriptor lists which levels it accepts.
